title: Specify the output shape
summary: An output format tells the tool how to arrange its answer. Ask for the fields or headings you actually need.
introduction: An output format tells the tool how to arrange its answer. Ask for the fields or headings you actually need. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.title: Specify the output shape

blocks.text: The requested result has two lines that can be inspected separately. The angle-bracket text is a placeholder to replace with source values.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Add a third line for time and require Not provided if missing.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: A neat format does not prove that the values are correct.
For more detail later, use this [Prompt Engineering further reading](https://www.promptingguide.ai/introduction).
